description:
Get the Faxbeep test fax numbers, the test email addresses and the limits. Call this first, before the person sends a test.

Each item of "numbers" is a test fax number: "local_format" is the number to dial inside its country, "international_format" from any other country. The person sends a fax to it from a fax machine or a fax service. Each item of "email_addresses" takes an email with one PDF, TIFF or JPEG attachment, for a scan-to-email or Internet fax test. "email_addresses" is left out while the email test is off.

Every test that Faxbeep receives is public on faxbeep.com for 30 days. Tell the person not to send a private document. "limits" has the limits of the email test: "email_max_message_bytes" is the size of the whole email, and email encoding adds about a third, so the attachment can be about three quarters of it. "troubleshooting_url" is the docs page with each refusal message of the email test and its fix.

"now" is the server time. Use it as "since" of list_test_faxes: call this tool, or take "now" from your last result, just before the person sends the test. Do not use your own clock.
name: get_test_numbers
title: Get the test numbers
